assumptions: This model is an exploratory envelope only and is not approved for manufacture or powered testing.
The 80 mm wheel, 24 mm width, 30 mm hub, and 8 mm hub projection reuse values from a separate CAD format test only as placeholders.
The 6 mm shaft, 12 mm outside by 6 mm inside by 4 mm bearing envelope, 30 mm square support plate, and 10 mm coupling envelope are unverified assumptions.
The Mabuchi FF-130 motor body dimensions are a candidate envelope from the existing design contract; the motor is not selected or approved.
The motor axis and wheel axis are assumed coaxial along global positive Y; vertical is global positive Z.
The coupling is shown only as a packaging envelope; motor-shaft and coupling bores are not modeled.
No tolerances, fits, materials, retention features, loads, motor supply, speed controller, PCB, or firmware are defined.
